newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chirac considers speech on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Chirac considers speech on Wednesday.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac is considering making a speech on Wednesday, the second anniversary of his election, an official at his office said on Monday.
She declined to say what form this would take.
"The president is considering speaking on May 7," she said.
French newspapers have said Chirac could intervene with a speech to the nation on Wednesday to help centre-right parties ahead of a two-round parliamentary election on May 25 and June 1.
